GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2011-11-14T16:45:42Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: How to handle textures in .obj files
Description: How can I use the texture informations in the .obj files to get coordinates for the texture.jpeg file? 

For me values between 1 and 0.1 like "vt 0.948307 0.566459" makes no sense... I expected something like coordinates for the texture JPEG file. Similar to "vt 454 232" for the pixel X = 454 Y = 232 in the texture JPEG file. 

In the convert_obj_three.py file is the following part: 

```
        # Texture coordinates in (u,v[,w]) coordinates, w is optional
        # vt 0.500 -1.352 [0.234]
        if chunks[0] == "vt" and len(chunks) >= 3:
            u = float(chunks[1])
            v = float(chunks[2])
            w = 0
            if len(chunks)>3:
                w = float(chunks[3])
            uvs.append([u,v,w])
```

But I can not find the part where the converter uses these informations to extract the color infos from the texture file. Can somebody give me a hint?
